content.rendered:
Thank you for your interest in enrolling at SCS!

We encourage everyone who is interested in Sherwood Charter School to attend one of our monthly tours. Held September-May, the tour allows you to see the classrooms and school in action.

Having trouble viewing the video? Click the arrow in the top right corner to open in a new window.

Any school age children (including incoming kindergarten students) are welcome to attend with you, however please make alternative care arrangements for children of all other ages. Tours last approximately 45 minutes.

Request a Tour

2026-2027 School Year

Applications for the 2026-2027 school year open on November 1, 2025.  Please apply using the link below, which will take you to our online lottery program, Lotterease.

Apply for the 2026-2027 School Year

Application deadlines for the 2026-2027 school year lotteries are as follows:

  • Winter Lottery, February 18, 2026 (Kindergarten only): Applications are due by February 17, 2026 by Noon.
  • Spring Lottery, April 15, 2026 (1st – 8th Grade): Applications are due by April 14, 2026 by Noon.

If you are in the Sherwood School District, please note that proof of address will be required upon enrollment by supplying 2 of the items listed below:

  • Mortgage Statement
  • Property Tax Statement
  • Rental Lease Agreement
  • Utility Bill (electricity, gas, water/sewer)
  • Oregon Driver’s License
  • Oregon Identification Card

Applications received after the application deadline will be added to the wait list in the order received. You will receive a confirmation email once your application has been processed. If you do not receive a confirmation, please email the office at office@sherwoodcharterschool.org or give us a call at 503-925-8007 to be sure your application was received.

Please note: applications will briefly close on February 17th at noon through February 18th, and on April 14th at noon through April 15th for lottery processing.

For help with applying through Lotterease, please see this Application Reference Guide or contact the school office at office@sherwoodcharterschool.org.

2025-2026 School Year

Applications for the 2025-2026 school year lottery opened on November 1, 2024. You will find the application link below.

Applications will be added to the wait list in the order received. You will receive a confirmation email once your application has been processed. If you do not receive a confirmation, please email the office at office@sherwoodcharterschool.org or give us a call at 503-925-8007 to be sure your application was received.

Apply for the 2025-2026 School Year

Kindergarten at SCS

At Sherwood Charter School, we believe that Kindergarten is a magical place where children can explore, discover, learn, play, paint and sing! Friendship workshop helps us make and keep friends. We learn in an engaging, hands-on environment where what we learn is connected to the world around us.

We don’t believe that Kindergarten is some version of “mini first grade.” We don’t teach to the test. We don’t sit in rows.

It all starts with an exceptional teacher and a passion for making the first year of school amazing! If you would like to come visit, sign up for a tour today!

How does enrollment work?

Sherwood Charter School is open to all students eligible to attend kindergarten through 8th grade. To be eligible for kindergarten enrollment, the student must be 5 years old by September 1st.

To apply for enrollment, an Application must be completed and turned in by the lottery deadline (see above for due dates). If the number of applications exceeds the number of available spaces in a grade level, an equitable lottery will be held to fill vacant seats for the next school year. After seats are filled, the drawing will continue to determine the order of a waiting list. Applicants are divided into “in-district” and “out-of-district” students, with priority given to siblings of current students, then in-district, and last out of district students. Names are selected randomly in a drawing.

Once enrolled, students are not required to enroll in subsequent lottery enrollment periods.

Key dates to know:

  • November 1st – Open Enrollment: Enrollment opens for new students for the next school year on November 1st. Pre-Applications are now accepted for the lottery and are available on our website.
  • February – Winter Lottery: Held for kindergarten only. If you have a child who will be in kindergarten for the next school year, your Application must be received by noon the day before the lottery to be included in the Winter Lottery.
  • April – Spring Lottery: Held for 1st-8th grade. If you have a child going into 1st through 8th grade, your Application must be received by noon the day before the lottery to be included in the lottery.

The full Enrollment and Lottery Procedures for Sherwood Charter School can be read here. If you have any questions please contact us.

Sherwood Charter School does not limit student enrollment based on race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, national origin, disability, the terms of an individualized education program, income level, proficiency in the English language, or athletic ability.
